$comment: Machine-readable Valyd capability matrix for AI agents. Each entry maps a real integration goal to its path, product, auth header, required credentials, whether it is billable, how PII is handled, whether a proof is saved to the user's Valyd account, and the agent-fetchable .md doc (root-relative; resolve against the docs host you fetched this file from). Every field is derived from the Agent Integration Guide (/ai/agent-guide) and llms.txt — nothing here is invented. Credentials cannot be minted by an agent; a human creates apps/keys in the Developer Portal.

capabilities.goal: Sign a user in and read their verified Valyd account (profile, licenses, verification proofs)
Read the proofs a signed-in user's account already holds (id_verified, age bands, licenses) — free, no check runs
capabilities.credential: the user's Bearer valyd_access_token (from Login with Valyd)

capabilities.goal: Run a verification for a signed-in user and save the passed proof to their Valyd ID; PII stays with Valyd
capabilities.credential: App X-API-Key + the user's valyd_access_token (attached to the check in the documented request field)

capabilities.goal: Run a one-off verification check on data you supply; the full result including extracted identity fields returns to your system for you to store and protect
Send the user to Valyd's hosted capture page for a composed workflow; the combined decision arrives on a signed webhook
capabilities.credential: App X-API-Key + workflow_id (add the user's valyd_access_token to the session to save proofs to their account instead of returning results to you)

capabilities.goal: Onboard and control a workforce as organization members (face-activation, owner/admin/developer/member roles, per-seat billing); track who logged in via the valyd_org_member_id claim
capabilities.credential: client_id + client_secret (Login with Valyd) + Members API headers X-Client-Id / X-Client-Secret (server-side only)
